title: My Hobbies
goal: Students can talk about their hobbies and free time activities using present simple and present continuous.
goal_vi: Học sinh có thể nói về sở thích và các hoạt động giải trí của mình bằng thì hiện tại đơn và hiện tại tiếp diễn.

Cheerful and vibrant colors.

grammar.title: Present Simple (for hobbies/routines)
grammar.explain_en: We use the present simple to talk about hobbies or things we do regularly.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì hiện tại đơn để nói về sở thích hoặc những việc chúng ta làm thường xuyên.
examples: She plays the piano every day.

grammar.title: Present Continuous (for actions now)
grammar.explain_en: We use the present continuous to talk about actions happening right now.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn để nói về những hành động đang diễn ra ngay bây giờ.
examples: I am reading a book now.

grammar.title: Can / Can't (for ability)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'can' to talk about what we are able to do, and 'can't' for what we are not able to do.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'can' để nói về những gì chúng ta có thể làm, và 'can't' cho những gì chúng ta không thể làm.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I can to ride a bike.

grammar.title: Wh-questions (What/When/Who for hobbies)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'wh-questions' to ask for specific information about hobbies or free time.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng câu hỏi 'wh-' để hỏi thông tin cụ thể về sở thích hoặc thời gian rảnh.
grammar.right: ✅ What do you like to do?

readings.title: My Free Time Fun
readings.text: Hi, my name is Minh. I am eight years old. I love my free time! After school, I often read books. I have many storybooks in my room. My favorite hobby is drawing. I can draw animals and people. Look! I am drawing a big elephant now. On weekends, I like to play outside with my friends. We ride our bikes and run in the park. My free time is always fun!

readings.title: Linh's Creative Hobbies
readings.text: Hello! I am Linh. I have many creative hobbies. My favorite hobby is painting. I have many colors, and I like to paint flowers and birds. Right now, I am painting a beautiful blue bird for my mom. It's a special gift! Another hobby I enjoy is making crafts. I can make paper animals and little boxes. They are fun to make. On Saturday mornings, I go to a singing club. I love to sing! My friends and I sing many English songs together. We are practicing a new song for our school show. My hobbies make me happy and busy.

readings.title: The Weekend Fun Club
readings.text: My name is Nam. Every Saturday, my friends and I meet at the 'Weekend Fun Club'. We have many exciting hobbies! Ben likes playing board games. He is very good at chess. Today, he is teaching Mai how to play a new game. Mai's hobby is cooking. She loves making simple desserts like cookies and fruit salads. Right now, she is looking at a recipe for chocolate cookies. We can't wait to taste them! My hobby is photography. I like taking pictures of nature and my friends. I have a small camera, and I am taking a picture of Ben and Mai now. We are also learning some basic Japanese words together. It's a bit hard, but very interesting! We are having a great time at the club because we can do many fun things. What do you like to do on weekends?

life_skill.title: BALANCE YOUR TIME
life_skill.intro: Having hobbies is wonderful, but it's also important to balance your time. Make sure you have enough time for schoolwork, family, friends, and rest, too!
life_skill.intro_vi: Có sở thích là điều tuyệt vời, nhưng điều quan trọng là phải cân bằng thời gian của bạn. Hãy đảm bảo bạn có đủ thời gian cho việc học, gia đình, bạn bè và cả nghỉ ngơi nữa!

classroom_game.name: Hobby Charades
steps_en: Each group gets a list of hobbies (e.g., reading, drawing, singing, playing guitar, cooking).
One student chooses a hobby from the list, without showing it to their group.
They act out the hobby using actions only, no talking.
Their group members guess the hobby. The first group to guess correctly gets a point.
Take turns until all hobbies are acted out.
steps_vi: Mỗi nhóm nhận một danh sách các sở thích (ví dụ: đọc sách, vẽ, hát, chơi ghi-ta, nấu ăn).
Một học sinh chọn một sở thích từ danh sách, không cho nhóm mình xem.
Bạn đó diễn tả sở thích đó bằng hành động, không được nói.
Các thành viên khác trong nhóm đoán sở thích. Nhóm nào đoán đúng đầu tiên sẽ được một điểm.
Luân phiên cho đến khi tất cả các sở thích được diễn tả.
